$description: Sina's own design tokens (house tokens). Values are decisions, not measurements: each carries `derivedFrom` (the pleurat-com token it was derived from) and `item` (the DS item that decided it). `pnpm tokens:build` emits src/app/(frontend)/theme.css and src/cssVariables.js from this file; CSS is never edited by hand (D-014). `items` is written by `pnpm docs:index`.

color.$description: One ground/paper, one panel, three inks, two hairlines, one accent (+ its foreground and focus ring), three status tints — per theme. Roles are emitted as --paper, --ink…; the shadcn slots (--background, --card…) are aliases so src/components/ui keeps working. The dark theme is a true slate, not an inversion (D-015).

brand.$description: PLACEHOLDER cobalt — the single accent (CTA, section tag, live data). DS-01 Q1 decides the real value; swap here and run pnpm tokens:build.

brand-foreground.$description: Text on brand. Light: paper on cobalt (≥ 7:1). Dark: ink on a lighter cobalt.

ink-2.$description: Body and readable meta (≥ 8:1 on paper).

ink-3.$description: Muted text, decorative codes (≥ 4.5:1 on paper).

line.$description: Hairline rules and borders: ink at 16 %.

panel.$description: Raised / muted surface: cards, chips, footer band.

paper.$description: Page surface. Light: near-neutral warm paper. Dark: true slate (this is the ground of DS-02).

ring.$description: Focus ring — a deliberate token, same hue as brand.

track-accent.$description: Warm construction-orange accent for the Tracks section — distinct from warning (amber) and danger (red).

font.$description: Two type roles (sans for reading, mono for labels/codes) plus a Persian partner face. Sizes are roles, not steps; fluid ones are {min, vw, max}. `font.fa.*` overrides are emitted inside :lang(fa).

ar.$description: Arabic overrides: same variable names, emitted inside :lang(ar). Reuses the fa-tuned scale (taller leading, no negative tracking, no uppercase) as a starting default; Vazirmatn already covers the Arabic subset.

eyebrow.$description: 13 px — Arabic at 12 px is unreadable.

fa.$description: Persian overrides: same variable names, emitted inside :lang(fa). Persian needs taller leading, no negative tracking, no uppercase, and a larger eyebrow floor.

eyebrow.$description: 13 px — Persian at 12 px is unreadable.

mono.$description: Labels, codes, numbers — a real mono (pleurat styled a sans).

ja.$description: Japanese overrides: same variable names, emitted inside :lang(ja). CJK needs taller leading everywhere, no negative tracking (kanji have no sidebearings to tighten), and a slightly tracked eyebrow instead of uppercase.

eyebrow.$description: Floor raised from pleurat's 10.5 px to 12 px (DS-09).

h1.$description: 37 px on mobile → 58 px at 1440 (pleurat shape).

medium.$description: Headings, buttons, labels — one weight step, like pleurat.

measure.$description: Max width of a body column (~66 characters at 18 px).

section.$description: Vertical padding of a page section.

radius.$description: Small, deliberate radii (DS-16: not pleurat's 0 px by accident). sm/md/lg/xl feed the shadcn utilities.

standard.$description: The one easing for almost everything.

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind breakpoints (template values kept); also emitted to src/cssVariables.js in px.
